toegepas.rede_vinder: 'vir 'n rede' calques English 'for a reason'; the Afrikaans idiom is 'met 'n rede'.
toegepas.fout: 'vir 'n rede' is a calque of English 'for a reason'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'met 'n rede' is the natural Afrikaans idiom and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Koue kom nie by jou hand in nie.
toegepas.na: Koue kom nie in jou hand in nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'by ... in' is an awkward preposition pair; 'in jou hand in' matches the earlier 'uit jou hand in die metaal in'.
toegepas.fout: 'by jou hand in' reads as entering through the hand rather than into it, which blurs the direction the sentence is about.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both versions say cold does not enter your hand, but 'in jou hand in' makes the direction exact and mirrors 'uit jou hand in die metaal in' two sentences earlier.

laat_vaar.voor: trek yster en die meeste staal aan
laat_vaar.na: trek yster en die meeste soorte staal aan
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'die meeste soorte staal' reads more naturally for a mass noun and matches the next sentence's 'Party soorte vlekvrye staal'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'die meeste staal' (most steel) and 'die meeste soorte staal' (most kinds of steel) are different claims, so the quantifier's scope moves, and the original is already natural.

vlae.teks: Wanneer 'n dun laag 'n metaal mettertyd donker en dof maak.
vlae.rede: A definition opening with 'Wanneer' is a sentence fragment; a fuller form would need restructuring the definition, so it is left for the reviewer or writer rather than changed.

vlae.teks: Juwele: goud bly blink, en silwer word net dof.
vlae.rede: 'net' can read as 'only goes dull (does not rust)' or as 'simply goes dull'; the intended sense cannot be confirmed without guessing, so it is not changed.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Verslyt' is the usual standard form for wearing away; 'slyt' reads dated.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'slyt' is current standard Afrikaans alongside 'verslyt', so this is a lateral swap.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: wanneer lug en water daarby uitkom
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Bykom' alone is vague; 'daarby uitkom' matches the study text's 'by die yster uitkom' and is clearer for Grade 5.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition, and 'wanneer lug en water bykom' is already idiomatic Afrikaans for air and water reaching the iron.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: en 'n krap in die verf laat die staal
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Says where the scratch is, so the learner links it to the paint in the previous clause; nothing new is added.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Verf lê bo-op' and 'daaronder' already place the scratch in the paint; the addition lengthens the sentence and repeats 'verf'.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Furniture is made, not built, in Afrikaans; 'maak' also fits buildings and bridges.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The one verb serves furniture, buildings and bridges; 'bou' is natural for two of the three, and 'maak geboue en brûe' is weaker, so this is a lateral move at best.
